name: How does a general contractor assist with the storm damage repair process?

mainEntity.name: How does a general contractor assist with the storm damage repair process?

acceptedAnswer.text: A contractor who provides storm repair support works alongside your insurance process to supply accurate, line-item repair scopes and handle the actual construction. While public adjusters or insurers calculate theoretical payouts, an active general contractor inspects the physical carpentry, drywall, tile, and framing needs directly on site. HH Remodeling acts as your single point of contact for the physical repairs, coordinating necessary finish work and licensed specialty trades so your home is rebuilt strictly according to proper building standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor assesses structural and interior damage, generates detailed repair scopes for claims, and manages the actual reconstruction trades.
